
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr><td class="t_f" id="postmessage_55134071">
<i class="pstatus"> 本帖最后由 yiyu805 于 2026-4-14 17:01 编辑 </i><br>
<br>
公司让每天定时往企业微信群里发鸡汤文，每天发，发，发。烦的很，就想从网上找找有什么自动发的教程。这了几个用轻联连接小应用的每天发早安励志的消息，感觉很垃圾，直接抛弃了。就想着每天自己添加，自动发送，找了一圈没找到，问了问淘宝，竟然说要写代码500元。有点黑，就用豆包写了一个，分享出来大家用： 需要自己建一个wps多维表格：4列，第一列：<font color="#a31515">数字</font>，第二列：<font color="#a31515">励志名言&nbsp;&nbsp;（自己百度你自己想发送的内容）&nbsp;&nbsp;第三列</font><font color="#a31515">单选项：下拉选项已发送/未发送（默认选未发送） 第四列：时间（会记录发送出去的时间） wps右上角选脚本-AirScript脚本</font><br>
<font color="#a31515">，新建一个复制进去，然后点自动化流程，建一个定时-再建一个动作选运行AirScript脚本，选到这个脚本就可以。点运行自己试一下，</font><br>
<font color="#a31515">脚本纯ai生成，如有违规，请删帖，<br>
</font><br>
<font color="#a31515"><br>
</font><br>
<font color="#008000">/**</font><br>
<font color="#008000"> * 名言库自动发送脚本（顺序版）</font><br>
<font color="#008000"> * 功能：每日按数字列顺序，选取第一条未发送的名言发送到企业微信群，并标记已发送。</font><br>
<font color="#008000"> * 使用：复制到 AirScript，设置定时自动化流程。</font><br>
<font color="#008000"> */</font><br>
<font color="#008000">// ==================== 配置区域 ====================</font><br>
<font color="#0000ff">const</font> <font color="#008080">WEBHOOK_URL</font> = <font color="#a31515">"换成自己的企业微信群机器人</font><font color="#5b636b"><font face="system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica, &amp;quot;"><font style="font-size:12px">Webhook地址：</font></font></font><font color="#a31515">"</font>;<br>
<font color="#0000ff">const</font> <font color="#008080">SHEET_ID</font> = <font color="#098658">1</font>;<br>
<font color="#0000ff">const</font> <font color="#008080">MESSAGE_PREFIX</font> = <font color="#a31515">"&amp;#127800; 亲爱的同事们，早上好 &amp;#128522;："</font>;<br>
<font color="#0000ff">const</font> <font color="#008080">FIELD_NUMBER</font> = <font color="#a31515">"数字"</font>;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;<font color="#008000">// A列：排序字段</font><br>
<font color="#0000ff">const</font> <font color="#008080">FIELD_QUOTE</font> = <font color="#a31515">"励志名言"</font>;&nbsp; &nbsp;<font color="#008000">// B列</font><br>
<font color="#0000ff">const</font> <font color="#008080">FIELD_STATUS</font> = <font color="#a31515">"单选项"</font>;&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#008000">// C列</font><br>
<font color="#0000ff">const</font> <font color="#008080">FIELD_TIME</font> = <font color="#a31515">"时间"</font>;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#008000">// D列</font><br>
<font color="#0000ff">const</font> <font color="#008080">STATUS_UNSENT</font> = <font color="#a31515">"未发送"</font>;<br>
<font color="#0000ff">const</font> <font color="#008080">STATUS_SENT</font> = <font color="#a31515">"已发送"</font>;<br>
<font color="#008000">// ==================== 配置结束 ====================</font><br>
<font color="#0000ff">function</font> getFieldKey(record, targetName) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> fields = record.fields || {};<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">if</font> (fields.hasOwnProperty(targetName)) <font color="#0000ff">return</font> targetName;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> normalizedTarget = targetName.replace(<font color="#800000">/\s+/</font><font color="#0000ff">g</font>, <font color="#a31515">''</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">for</font> (<font color="#0000ff">const</font> key <font color="#0000ff">in</font> fields) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">if</font> (key.replace(<font color="#800000">/\s+/</font><font color="#0000ff">g</font>, <font color="#a31515">''</font>) === normalizedTarget) <font color="#0000ff">return</font> key;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">return</font> <font color="#0000ff">null</font>;<br>
}<br>
<font color="#0000ff">function</font> sendToWecom(content) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">if</font> (!content || <font color="#0000ff">typeof</font> content !== <font color="#a31515">'string'</font> || content.trim() === <font color="#a31515">''</font>) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.error(<font color="#a31515">"&amp;#10060; 消息内容为空，取消发送"</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">return</font> <font color="#0000ff">false</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">try</font> {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">const</font> payload = { msgtype: <font color="#a31515">"text"</font>, text: { content: content } };<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">const</font> resp = <font color="#008080">HTTP</font>.post(<font color="#008080">WEBHOOK_URL</font>, <font color="#008080">JSON</font>.stringify(payload), {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;timeout: <font color="#098658">10000</font>,<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;headers: { <font color="#a31515">'Content-Type'</font>: <font color="#a31515">'application/json'</font> }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;});<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">const</font> result = resp.json();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.log(<font color="#a31515">`企业微信响应：errcode=</font>${result.errcode}<font color="#a31515">, errmsg=</font>${result.errmsg}<font color="#a31515">`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">return</font> result.errcode === <font color="#098658">0</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; } <font color="#0000ff">catch</font> (e) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.error(<font color="#a31515">`发送失败：</font>${e.message}<font color="#a31515">`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">return</font> <font color="#0000ff">false</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
}<br>
<font color="#0000ff">function</font> getCurrentTimeString() {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> now = <font color="#0000ff">new</font> <font color="#008080">Date</font>();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> pad = (n) =&gt; <font color="#008080">String</font>(n).padStart(<font color="#098658">2</font>, <font color="#a31515">'0'</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">return</font> <font color="#a31515">`</font>${now.getFullYear()}<font color="#a31515">-</font>${pad(now.getMonth()+<font color="#098658">1</font>)}<font color="#a31515">-</font>${pad(now.getDate())}<font color="#a31515"> </font>${pad(now.getHours())}<font color="#a31515">:</font>${pad(now.getMinutes())}<font color="#a31515">:</font>${pad(now.getSeconds())}<font color="#a31515">`</font>;<br>
}<br>
<font color="#0000ff">function</font> main() {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; console.log(<font color="#a31515">"========== 名言发送任务开始（顺序模式）=========="</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; console.log(<font color="#a31515">`执行时间：</font>${getCurrentTimeString()}<font color="#a31515">`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#008000">// 1. 获取记录</font><br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">let</font> allRecords = <font color="#008080">Application</font>.<font color="#008080">Record</font>.<font color="#008080">GetRecords</font>({ <font color="#008080">SheetId</font>: <font color="#008080">SHEET_ID</font> });<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">if</font> (!<font color="#008080">Array</font>.isArray(allRecords) &amp;&amp; allRecords &amp;&amp; <font color="#008080">Array</font>.isArray(allRecords.records)) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;allRecords = allRecords.records;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">if</font> (!<font color="#008080">Array</font>.isArray(allRecords)) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.error(<font color="#a31515">"数据格式异常，任务终止"</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">return</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; console.log(<font color="#a31515">`总记录数：</font>${allRecords.length}<font color="#a31515">`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#008000">// 2. 动态获取字段键名</font><br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">if</font> (allRecords.length === <font color="#098658">0</font>) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.log(<font color="#a31515">"表格无数据，任务结束"</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">return</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> numberKey = getFieldKey(allRecords[<font color="#098658">0</font>], <font color="#008080">FIELD_NUMBER</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> quoteKey = getFieldKey(allRecords[<font color="#098658">0</font>], <font color="#008080">FIELD_QUOTE</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">if</font> (!quoteKey) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.error(<font color="#a31515">`&amp;#10060; 无法定位"</font>${<font color="#008080">FIELD_QUOTE</font>}<font color="#a31515">"字段`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">return</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; console.log(<font color="#a31515">`字段检测：数字列为"</font>${numberKey || <font color="#a31515">'未找到'</font>}<font color="#a31515">"，名言列为"</font>${quoteKey}<font color="#a31515">"`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#008000">// 3. 筛选未发送且内容有效的记录</font><br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> unsentRecords = [];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">for</font> (<font color="#0000ff">const</font> rec <font color="#0000ff">of</font> allRecords) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">const</font> fields = rec.fields || {};<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">let</font> statusValue = fields[<font color="#008080">FIELD_STATUS</font>];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">if</font> (<font color="#008080">Array</font>.isArray(statusValue)) statusValue = statusValue[<font color="#098658">0</font>];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">if</font> (statusValue === <font color="#008080">STATUS_UNSENT</font>) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">const</font> quote = fields[quoteKey];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">if</font> (quote &amp;&amp; <font color="#0000ff">typeof</font> quote === <font color="#a31515">'string'</font> &amp;&amp; quote.trim() !== <font color="#a31515">''</font>) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; unsentRecords.push(rec);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;} <font color="#0000ff">else</font> {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; console.warn(<font color="#a31515">`记录 </font>${rec.id}<font color="#a31515"> 名言为空，已跳过`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;}<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; console.log(<font color="#a31515">`未发送且内容有效的记录数：</font>${unsentRecords.length}<font color="#a31515">`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">if</font> (unsentRecords.length === <font color="#098658">0</font>) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.log(<font color="#a31515">"&amp;#9888;&amp;#65039; 没有可发送的名言，任务结束。"</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">return</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#008000">// 4. 按数字列排序（升序），选出第一条</font><br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; unsentRecords.sort((a, b) =&gt; {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">const</font> fieldsA = a.fields || {};<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">const</font> fieldsB = b.fields || {};<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">let</font> numA = fieldsA[numberKey] || fieldsA[<font color="#008080">FIELD_NUMBER</font>] || <font color="#098658">0</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">let</font> numB = fieldsB[numberKey] || fieldsB[<font color="#008080">FIELD_NUMBER</font>] || <font color="#098658">0</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#008000">// 确保是数字类型</font><br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;numA = <font color="#008080">Number</font>(numA);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;numB = <font color="#008080">Number</font>(numB);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">return</font> numA - numB;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; });<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> selected = unsentRecords[<font color="#098658">0</font>];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> quote = selected.fields[quoteKey];<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> recordId = selected.id;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> numberValue = selected.fields[numberKey] || selected.fields[<font color="#008080">FIELD_NUMBER</font>] || <font color="#a31515">'?'</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; console.log(<font color="#a31515">`选中记录：数字列 = </font>${numberValue}<font color="#a31515">，ID = </font>${recordId}<font color="#a31515">`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; console.log(<font color="#a31515">`名言内容：</font>${quote}<font color="#a31515">`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#008000">// 5. 发送消息</font><br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> message = <font color="#a31515">`</font>${<font color="#008080">MESSAGE_PREFIX</font>}<font color="#a31515">\n\n</font>${quote}<font color="#a31515">`</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> success = sendToWecom(message);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">if</font> (!success) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.error(<font color="#a31515">"发送失败，不更新记录"</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#0000ff">return</font>;<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#008000">// 6. 更新状态和时间</font><br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">const</font> nowStr = getCurrentTimeString();<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; <font color="#0000ff">try</font> {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<font color="#008080">Application</font>.<font color="#008080">Record</font>.<font color="#008080">UpdateRecords</font>({<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;<font color="#008080">SheetId</font>: <font color="#008080">SHEET_ID</font>,<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;<font color="#008080">Records</font>: [{<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; id: recordId,<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; fields: {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[<font color="#008080">FIELD_STATUS</font>]: <font color="#008080">STATUS_SENT</font>,<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[<font color="#008080">FIELD_TIME</font>]: nowStr<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;}]<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;});<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.log(<font color="#a31515">`&amp;#9989; 记录已更新为"已发送"，时间：</font>${nowStr}<font color="#a31515">`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; } <font color="#0000ff">catch</font> (e) {<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;console.error(<font color="#a31515">`更新记录失败：</font>${e.message}<font color="#a31515">`</font>);<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; }<br>
&nbsp; &nbsp; console.log(<font color="#a31515">"========== 任务完成 =========="</font>);<br>
}<br>
main();</td></tr></tbody></table>
